# Nimbus Grid source

- MotionSites listing: https://motionsites.ai/?prompt=nimbus-grid
- Download from GitHub: https://github.com/vikod3/cloud_storage_ai_website
- Snapshot commit: 6c8cb787ed4c093f2176d45e8737dcf3c45fc7d8
- Retrieved: 2026-10-26

`original.html`, `original.js` and `styles.css` are verbatim upstream files. The repository does not include a separate LICENSE file; this source is linked as a download by MotionSites. No paid login, asset download, or prompt quota was bypassed.

The portfolio keeps the source hero, console tabs, header and scrolling accordion structure. Product text/art replace the cloud-storage content. `runtime.js` wraps the upstream script in a mount function, with integration changes for reduced motion and keyboard tabs. `nimbus-adapter.css` handles existing portfolio content, Korean typography and 3D controls. Existing product data and 3D geometry are independent of the template.

The previous Duolingo item provides a generation prompt, not implementation code. It is not the implementation source of this revision.
